name: Mega-City One (2012)
note: Fan work: Mega-City One as the 2012 film has it, which is a different city from the comics one at /megacity and deliberately so. Judge Dredd belongs to Rebellion and the film to its rights holders; nothing from either is used. Generated by tools/make-dredd2012.py: a flat dusty low-rise sprawl with twenty enormous plain concrete Mega-Blocks standing out of it, one of which is Peach Trees. Positions are [lat, lon].

smog._: the dust that never settles over the sprawl

districts._: [name, hex colour, base height, tallest, box as [lat south, lon west, lat north, lon east]]

landmarks.name: Peach Trees
landmarks.info: Two hundred storeys, seventy-five thousand people, and a blast shield in a housing on every band of every face. Once they come down the block is sealed: no doors, no windows, nothing in or out. Nobody outside can get in, and nobody inside is going anywhere.

landmarks.name: Sector House 13
landmarks.info: Where the Judges work out of. The sprawl does not come to it and it does not go to the sprawl unless it has to.

landmarks.name: The Yards
landmarks.info: Sheds, holding pens and whatever the blocks cannot make for themselves.

landmarks.name: The City Wall
landmarks.info: Sixty-four metres of concrete along the eastern edge, and past it the Cursed Earth, which is desert and nothing else.

warMode._: blast shields on every mega-block; the toggle drops the ones on this block
